an5.208:1.1: CCVIII. Pañc'ime bhikkhave ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane. Katame pañca? Acakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo na visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ pariyonaddhanti, bhattaṃ assa na cchādeti. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane.
an5.208:2.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane. Katame pañca? Cakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ na duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ na pariyonaddhanti, bhattaṃ assa chādeti. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane ti.
